scripts.build: node scripts/sync-pdfgpu.mjs && node scripts/verify-release-contract.mjs && turbo run build
scripts.deploy: node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && npm run build && docker compose rm -sf pdfit && docker compose up -d --build --force-recreate --remove-orphans pdfit
